lines.en: Liberators, I am a friend. For allowing me to be free, I am in your debt. I am Narima.
lines.zh: 解放我的人，我没有恶意。你们放了我自由，我欠你们一份人情。我叫娜瑞玛。
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Protagonist. Well met. You were one of the slaves here, Narima?
lines.zh: 我是Protagonist。幸会。娜瑞玛，你是这里的奴隶吗？

lines.en: ...Yes. I was to be sold as a slave. But before that, I wanted to free them.
lines.zh: ……是的。我被贩作了奴隶。在此之前，我曾想要给他们带来自由。
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Then you are indeed a friend...  please join us for now, Narima. We could use your knowledge of the Tidereavers for sure.
lines.zh: 那你确实是我们自己人…… 娜瑞玛，欢迎加入我们。你对噬浪海贼团的了解肯定能帮到我们。

lines.en: My blade is yours to command, Protagonist.
lines.zh: Protagonist，汝心之所向，即吾刃之所指。
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Donar has granted me allies...  I will finally be free of these monsters!
lines.zh: 多纳尔将盟友赐予了我…… 我终于可以摆脱这些怪物了！
lines.name: 娜瑞玛
